does: Gives the AI score of the attack range a character has left after a jump, memoised per (source, target) pair in the helper's list at +0x2D0 and computed on first use by a function the registry does not name.

evidence.says: linear search of the 0x18-byte entries at +0x2D0/+0x2DC by the two entity handles, returning the cached AiScore with its count at +0x34 raised; else calls the computing function, a small body comparing the movement left after the jump to the attack range, and appends the result
A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a fight was on, from one place in the AI's scoring code: it ran in a fight, which does not show what it does
EoCServer.dll exports this name; the symbol database finds the export again in the executable at this function by the likeness of the two pseudo-codes

questions.ask: reading of the body is thin; a goblin with Jump in a fight would show when it is called
